stage=/var/tmp/botsquad-late-close-20261014

assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM investment_loop_occurrences WHERE loop_id='6a8ca917-3dec-414e-ad33-a31eea6cb194' AND state='pending' AND attempts=0").fetchone()[0]==13
fdb=sqlite3.connect('file:/var/lib/botsquad/.botsquad/finite-hq-authority/authority.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
assert fdb.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='approve'").fetchone()[0]==1
assert fdb.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='reserve'").fetchone()[0]==4
assert fdb.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='collection_reserve'").fetchone()[0]==9

assert c.execute('PRAGMA quick_check').fetchone()[0]=='ok'
assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM executions WHERE status='running'").fetchone()[0]==0
assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM execution_runtime_attempts WHERE unresolved=1').fetchone()[0]==0

assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM financial_attempts a LEFT JOIN financial_attempt_results r ON r.attempt_id=a.attempt_id WHERE r.attempt_id IS NULL').fetchone()[0]==0
grant=c.execute("SELECT id,envelope FROM investment_public_grants WHERE channel_id='6790c271ea4b4246c22607c59da5ba683a9aa6777309505b' AND state='active'").fetchone();assert grant
g=json.loads(grant[1]);now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);assert now.isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')<g['expiresAt']
attempts=c.execute('SELECT attempted_at FROM investment_public_attempts WHERE grant_id=?',(grant[0],)).fetchall();assert len(attempts)+2<=g['maxAttempts']
assert sum(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(a[0].replace('Z','+00:00'))>now-datetime.timedelta(seconds=60) for a in attempts)+2<=g['writesPerMinute']
assert c.execute("SELECT state,generation FROM investment_loops WHERE loop_id='fa172653-d755-46df-83b5-b52becaf8821'").fetchone()==('stopped',3)
assert c.execute("SELECT head_version,head_hash FROM investment_runs WHERE run_id='observed_f78ef11e-88dd-45fe-ba47-ac6694ed184f'").fetchone()==(4,'f48f93d85667917f9022ededcf5dc1e7bee793bf00f22fd147d9a7b846e22478')
p=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/var/lib/botsquad-publication-custody/checkpoint.json').read_text());assert p['state']=='completed'
f=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/var/lib/botsquad/.botsquad/finite-hq-custody/checkpoint.json').read_text());assert f['sequence']==57 and f['digest']=='2662178a3eb09f3984a5505b8e9d431a38dd2aa54486165596a3d170d0eb2bd8'
assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)<datetime.datetime(2026,10,14,19,0,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
print('Preflight passed; matched staged production inputs:',len(selected),flush=True)
PY
backup=/var/backups/botsquad/investment-draft-repair-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
install -d -o root -g root -m 700 "$backup"
cp /etc/botsquad/deployment "$backup/deployment"
cp /etc/botsquad-ask-launch/publication-restart.json "$backup/previous-restart-config.json"
cp /var/lib/botsquad-publication-custody/checkpoint.json "$backup/previous-publication-permit.json"
printf '%s\n' "$old" > "$backup/previous-sha"
printf '%s\n' "$candidate" > "$backup/target-sha"
# The currently reconciled live process alone arms the next one-use permit on shutdown.
python3 - "$candidate" <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,os,sys,uuid
p=pathlib.Path('/etc/botsquad-ask-launch/publication-restart.json');v=json.loads(p.read_text());assert v['targetSha']=='fbd26f520e7403a469643ed350df5e08bbc1ec2b';v['targetSha']=sys.argv[1]
st=p.stat();tmp=p.with_name(p.name+'.'+str(uuid.uuid4()));fd=os.open(tmp,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600);os.fchown(fd,st.st_uid,st.st_gid)
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:json.dump(v,f);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp,p);fd=os.open(p.parent,os.O_RDONLY);os.fsync(fd);os.close(fd)
PY
systemctl stop botsquad.service
test "$(systemctl show botsquad -p MainPID --value)" = 0
test "$(systemctl show botsquad -p ActiveState --value)" = inactive
python3 - "$backup" "$candidate" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,pathlib,sys,json,hashlib,datetime
b=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);p=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/var/lib/botsquad-publication-custody/checkpoint.json').read_text());assert p['state']=='ready' and p['targetSha']==sys.argv[2] and p['claimedBy'] is None
(b/'live-shutdown-permit.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2))
for source,name in [('/var/lib/botsquad/company.sqlite','company-schema29.sqlite'),('/var/lib/botsquad/.botsquad/finite-hq-authority/authority.sqlite','finite-authority.sqlite')]:
 c=sqlite3.connect('file:'+source+'?mode=ro',uri=True);out=sqlite3.connect(str(b/name));c.backup(out);out.close();c.close()
(b/'finite-checkpoint.json').write_bytes(pathlib.Path('/var/lib/botsquad/.botsquad/finite-hq-custody/checkpoint.json').read_bytes())
for p in b.iterdir():p.chmod(0o600)
(b/'backup-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'files':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in b.iterdir() if p.is_file()},'credentialsCopied':False,'restoringSpentAuthorityPermitted':False},indent=2))
print('Live shutdown handoff and stopped backup:',str(b),flush=True)
PY
# Reuse the reviewed, tested compiled stage. Do not run the first-only restart helper.
umask 022
git checkout --detach "$candidate"
newdist=/opt/botsquad/dist-investment-draft-repair
test ! -e "$newdist"
mkdir "$newdist"
cp -a "$stage/dist/." "$newdist/"
chown -R root:root "$newdist"
chmod -R a+rX,go-w "$newdist"
mv dist "$backup/old-dist-tree"
mv "$newdist" dist
umask 077
printf 'BOT_DEPLOYED_SHA=%s\n' "$candidate" > /etc/botsquad/deployment
systemctl start botsquad.service
for attempt in {1..30}; do
 if curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:4310/api/health > "$backup/health.json"; then break; fi
 sleep 1
done
python3 - "$backup" "$candidate" <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,sys,sqlite3,subprocess,datetime
b=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);h=json.loads((b/'health.json').read_text());assert h['commit']==sys.argv[2] and h['alive'] and h['database'] and h['dispatcher']
p=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/var/lib/botsquad-publication-custody/checkpoint.json').read_text());assert p['state']=='completed' and p['targetSha']==sys.argv[2]
assert p['id']==json.loads((b/'live-shutdown-permit.json').read_text())['id']
c=sqlite3.connect('file:/var/lib/botsquad/company.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM investment_public_controls WHERE action='clean_restart_reconciled' AND json_extract(detail,'$.permitId')=?",(p['id'],)).fetchone()[0]==1
assert c.execute("SELECT state,generation FROM investment_loops WHERE loop_id='fa172653-d755-46df-83b5-b52becaf8821'").fetchone()==('stopped',3)
assert c.execute("SELECT generation,reconciled_generation FROM investment_public_channels WHERE id='6790c271ea4b4246c22607c59da5ba683a9aa6777309505b'").fetchone()==('1','1')
r={'checkedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'health':h,'backup':str(b),'publicationPermitCompleted':True,'oldLoopStoppedNewDraftUnapproved':True,'service':subprocess.check_output(['systemctl','show','botsquad','-p','MainPID,ActiveState,MemorySwapMax,LimitCORE'],text=True).splitlines()}
(b/'deployment-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2));print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
PY

"""Owner-authorized local HTTP recovery. Never edits company/authority databases."""
import urllib.request,json,uuid,datetime,pathlib,hashlib,os,sys,subprocess,sqlite3
phase=sys.argv[1];directory=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]);directory.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def save(name,value):
 p=directory/name
 with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2)
 p.chmod(0o600)
base='http://127.0.0.1:4310'
token=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/session',timeout=5))['csrfToken']
def post(path,value):
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/api/investment-run/observed/recovery/'+path,data=json.dumps(value).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-BotSquad-Token':token},method='POST')
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=100) as r:return json.load(r)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
  body=e.read().decode();save('failure-'+str(uuid.uuid4())+'.json',{'phase':phase,'path':path,'status':e.code,'body':body});raise RuntimeError('Recovery HTTP action failed; protected diagnostic retained') from None
if phase=='revise-release':
 original=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/botsquad/investment-recovery-20261014-close');prepared=json.loads((original/'prepared.json').read_text())
 assert prepared['scope']['scopeId']=='68ab0223-32b5-4a02-a7aa-a70ee9bc20dc'
 assert prepared['preparedHead']=='f48f93d85667917f9022ededcf5dc1e7bee793bf00f22fd147d9a7b846e22478'
 assert not (original/'approved.json').exists()
 def digest(value):
  result=subprocess.run(['/opt/botsquad-runtime/node/bin/node','--input-type=module','-e',"import {hash} from '/opt/botsquad/dist/src/domain/investment/identity.js';let s='';for await (const c of process.stdin)s+=c;process.stdout.write(hash(JSON.parse(s)));"],input=json.dumps(value),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
  assert len(result.stdout)==64
  return result.stdout
 c=sqlite3.connect('file:/var/lib/botsquad/.botsquad/finite-hq-authority/authority.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
 assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='approve'").fetchone()[0]==1
 assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='reserve'").fetchone()[0]==4
 assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='collection_reserve'").fetchone()[0]==9
 save('original-prepared.json',prepared);save('owner-scope.json',json.loads((original/'owner-scope.json').read_text()))
 research=(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)+datetime.timedelta(minutes=10)).replace(microsecond=0)
 assert research<datetime.datetime(2026,10,14,19,30,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
 request={'scopeId':prepared['scope']['scopeId'],'preparedHead':prepared['preparedHead'],'preparationDigest':digest(prepared),'researchAt':research.isoformat(timespec='milliseconds').replace('+00:00','Z'),'ownerReceiptHash':prepared['recovery']['amendment']['ownerReceiptHash'],'receiptId':'close-revise-'+str(uuid.uuid4())}
 save('revision-request.json',request);revised=post('revise',request);save('prepared.json',revised)
 assert revised['scope']==prepared['scope'] and revised['preparedHead']==prepared['preparedHead'] and revised['loop']['loopId']==prepared['loop']['loopId']
 assert revised['recovery']['researchAt']==request['researchAt'] and revised['recovery']['amendment']==prepared['recovery']['amendment']
 release={'scopeId':revised['scope']['scopeId'],'preparedHead':revised['preparedHead'],'preparationDigest':digest(revised),'receiptId':'close-release-revised-'+str(uuid.uuid4())}
 save('release-request.json',release);approved=post('release',release);save('approved.json',approved)
 assert approved['recovery']['executionId']==prepared['recovery']['executionId'] and approved['recovery']['oldAuthorityId']==prepared['recovery']['oldAuthorityId']
 print(json.dumps({'phase':phase,'scopeId':approved['scopeId'],'authorityId':approved['authorityId'],'runId':approved['runId'],'loopId':revised['loop']['loopId'],'preparedHead':revised['preparedHead'],'researchAt':revised['recovery']['researchAt'],'maxAdditional':7,'originalGapRetained':True,'activated':False,'receiptDirectory':str(directory)}))
elif phase=='activate':
 approved=json.loads((directory/'approved.json').read_text());prepared=json.loads((directory/'prepared.json').read_text());request={'scopeId':approved['scopeId'],'receiptId':'close-activate-'+str(uuid.uuid4())};save('activate-request.json',request);result=post('activate',request);save('activated.json',result);assert result['loop']['state']=='active'
 print(json.dumps({'phase':phase,'scopeId':approved['scopeId'],'authorityId':approved['authorityId'],'loop':result['loop'],'receiptDirectory':str(directory)}))
else:raise ValueError('Unknown phase')

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
test "$EUID" = 0
receipts=${1:?protected recovery receipt directory required}
candidate=${2:?exact deployed source required}
export PATH=/opt/botsquad-runtime/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
cd /opt/botsquad
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$candidate"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - "$receipts" "$candidate" <<'PY'

mem=dict(x.split(':',1) for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines());assert int(mem['MemAvailable'].split()[0])>=786432

assert c.execute("SELECT state FROM investment_loops WHERE loop_id=?",(prepared['loop']['loopId'],)).fetchone()[0]=='draft'
assert c.execute("SELECT state FROM investment_loops WHERE loop_id='fa172653-d755-46df-83b5-b52becaf8821'").fetchone()[0]=='stopped'
assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM executions WHERE status='running'").fetchone()[0]==0
assert c.execute("SELECT execution_priority,status FROM workers WHERE worker_id='worker_c5d3c228-ef9f-4b20-b951-2ac9dab48ac1'").fetchone()==('critical','idle')
assert c.execute("SELECT execution_priority,status FROM workers WHERE worker_id='worker_85bebccd-fb82-48c3-abfa-bc62117f8746'").fetchone()==('normal','idle')
assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM financial_attempts a LEFT JOIN financial_attempt_results r ON r.attempt_id=a.attempt_id WHERE r.attempt_id IS NULL').fetchone()[0]==0

assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM investment_loop_occurrences WHERE state='running'").fetchone()[0]==0
assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM investment_public_jobs WHERE state!='delivered' OR needs_receipt!=0 OR lease IS NOT NULL OR receipt IS NULL").fetchone()[0]==0
assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM investment_public_attempts a LEFT JOIN investment_public_results r ON r.attempt_id=a.id WHERE r.attempt_id IS NULL').fetchone()[0]==0
assert c.execute("SELECT completeness,settled FROM ai_usage WHERE execution_id='execution_ec78843c-0b56-4343-9d38-a6ba223867be'").fetchone()==('incomplete',1)
grant=c.execute("SELECT id,envelope FROM investment_public_grants WHERE channel_id='6790c271ea4b4246c22607c59da5ba683a9aa6777309505b' AND state='active'").fetchone();assert grant
g=json.loads(grant[1]);assert now.isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')<g['expiresAt'];attempts=c.execute('SELECT attempted_at FROM investment_public_attempts WHERE grant_id=?',(grant[0],)).fetchall();assert len(attempts)+2<=g['maxAttempts'];assert sum(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(a[0].replace('Z','+00:00'))>now-datetime.timedelta(seconds=60) for a in attempts)+2<=g['writesPerMinute']
f=sqlite3.connect('file:/var/lib/botsquad/.botsquad/finite-hq-authority/authority.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True);rows=f.execute("SELECT payload FROM events WHERE kind='approve'").fetchall();assert len(rows)==2 and json.loads(rows[-1][0])==approved
assert f.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='reserve'").fetchone()[0]==4
assert f.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='collection_reserve'").fetchone()[0]==9
assert json.loads(pathlib.Path('/var/lib/botsquad-publication-custody/checkpoint.json').read_text())['state']=='completed'
config=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/etc/botsquad-ask-launch/publication-restart.json').read_text());assert config['targetSha']==sys.argv[2]
print(json.dumps({'preflight':'passed','newAuthority':approved['authorityId'],'preparedHead':prepared['preparedHead']}),flush=True)
PY
backup=/var/backups/botsquad/investment-selector-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
